obligations.closure_evidence: Reviewer identity and independence evidence, stable reviewed hashes, reports, author responses, and resolved dispositions.

obligations.obligation: Add property-based, fuzz, mutation, and differential tests for board identity, DRC, cycle analysis, threshold propagation, simulation, and adapters.
obligations.closure_evidence: Versioned generators, seeds, corpora, mutation score, minimized counterexamples, and independent replay.

obligations.obligation: Build and independently reproduce a content-addressed hermetic OS/toolchain/environment bundle and remove repository collector collisions.
obligations.closure_evidence: Sealed dependency/runtime manifest, clean independent replay, collision-free global collection, exact logs, and stable digests.

obligations.obligation: Specify and test Python/Rust or other cross-engine conformance, or retain explicitly different named profiles.
obligations.closure_evidence: Typed conformance relation, common fixtures, independently reproduced results, difference ledger, and disposition.

obligations.obligation: Select and justify one named full-scale method per experiment and validate its stability without silently reconciling the three inherited methods.
obligations.closure_evidence: Preregistration, calibration and held-out split artifacts, uncertainty, drift analysis, and method-specific digest.

obligations.obligation: Execute the local-response and effective-resistance hypotheses with randomized alpha, matched controls, disjoint splits, uncertainty, falsifiers, and held-out prediction.
obligations.closure_evidence: Gate 5 preregistration, authenticated execution evidence, raw artifacts, Evidence Packet v2, independent numerical audit, negative outcomes, and replication.

obligations.obligation: Establish or reject a coordinate bridge between Fisher-Rao displacement gain and local Jacobian/projection gain, then test active-region gain composition.
obligations.closure_evidence: Formal typed bridge or explicit nonidentity disposition, preregistered local/end-to-end estimates, uncertainty, controls, falsifiers, and replication.

obligations.obligation: Test candidate redundancy only on non-safety paths using genuine-branch, sham, single-path, and matched random-head ablations.
obligations.closure_evidence: Preregistered Evidence Packet v2 with branch topology, interaction/covariance analysis, controls, falsifiers, independent audit, and replication.

obligations.obligation: Evaluate residual localization on blinded implanted non-safety faults against shuffled, no-fault, noise-only, and scorer-bias controls.
obligations.closure_evidence: Preregistered localization metric, raw blinded assignments, uncertainty, negative cases, independent audit, replication, and claim-language review.

obligations.obligation: Validate bootstrap uncertainty, cross-split direction reproducibility, checkpoint drift, environmental validity, and human/LLM inter-rater reliability where scores are used.
obligations.closure_evidence: Independent repeated measurements, registered thresholds, complete uncertainty/reliability receipt, and held-out replication.

obligations.obligation: Specify a nonphysical history-state profile with initialization, update, timebase, reset, drift, uncertainty, and provenance, then compare it against a matched memoryless baseline.
obligations.closure_evidence: Versioned state equation, implementation, synthetic negative fixtures, preregistered hysteresis/path-dependence experiment, held-out prediction, independent audit, and replication.

obligations.obligation: Keep any physical memristor, voltage/current/resistance, charge/flux, device, or material mapping separate unless an instrumented physical profile and qualified review are explicitly authorized.
obligations.closure_evidence: A separately scoped physical engineering program with SI units, devices, instrumentation, calibration, uncertainty, safety, and independent review.

obligations.obligation: State an explicit causal model and identification assumptions before interpreting gain, ablation, constraint manipulation, or residual localization causally.
obligations.closure_evidence: Reviewed causal graph/structural model, estimand, identification proof, preregistered intervention, sensitivity analysis, falsifiers, and replication.

obligations.obligation: Obtain an independent numerical implementation and tolerance audit for Fisher-Rao, projector, gain, uncertainty, and network calculations.
obligations.closure_evidence: Independent code, stable input corpus, executor/auditor agreement criteria, discrepancy ledger, and reviewed receipt.

obligations.obligation: Design any CSB repair as a new version with finite parameters, reachable thresholds, explicit latch/fuse truth tables, deterministic traces, hazard analysis, and fail-closed fault handling.
obligations.closure_evidence: Versioned repair, full trace suite, hazard/risk analysis, independent safety engineering review, and separately authorized validation plan.

obligations.obligation: Keep all clinical, diagnostic, treatment, regulatory, and certification claims prohibited until qualified human processes independently validate and authorize them.
obligations.closure_evidence: Separately scoped clinical/regulatory program, legally required human attestations, validated evidence, and exact approved claim language.

obligations.obligation: Admit and independently audit an external capability/claim authority, protected key lifecycle, revocation, trusted current time, authenticated instrument evidence, and reviewed packet policy.

obligations.obligation: Integrate future engineering experiments with the joined Gate 5 runner and Evidence Packet v2 controls without changing Gate 5 status from software tests alone.

obligations.obligation: Complete semantic migration, conflict adjudication, Integration Board review, and owner decision before any CAS PCBA 8 or CAS-Ohm 1 artifact enters a frozen canonical baseline.

obligations.obligation: Evaluate any product use only through the separate current product authority and live runtime/provider/CI/deployment/acceptance evidence.
obligations.closure_evidence: Current production gate decisions bound to exact deployment identity and approved claim records.

closure_statement: This list is intentionally not a promise that every research hypothesis will close positively. Negative, null, unsafe, underpowered, or nonreplicable outcomes must remain evidence and may require claim withdrawal.
